value.rationale: Nijs–Impens motivate functions needing multiple surviving members. Protecting two of three ecosystem processes is a natural partial-function persistence target. The exact seven-species onset marks the smallest budget at which the maximizer genuinely depends on the common extinction risk; the all-budget reversal explains why sacrificing one under-supported guild can be optimal under severe loss, while distributing species among all three wins near certain survival. This is a structural budget-allocation distinction and not a mere one-case numerical table.
